product_metadata.title: DECONATE Bathroom Rug Mat|Cotton Bathroom Mat/Rug |Soft, Absorbent & Durable Plush Rug |Easy Clean Modern Bath Mats Ideal for Bathroom, Entrance 25inch magn_Black_3p
features: EXTREMELY SOFT FEEL - 100% cotton bath mat will feel soft against your feet keeping them gentle and soft. These long stylish runners are constructed with soft, absorbent, 100% cotton material to soak up excess water on floors after exiting the tub or shower.

DIMENSIONS: Pack include 1 unit of 25 Inches round; These bath rugs are highly durable. The attractive and classic square loop design of this shower mat naturally matches any color scheme, providing long-lasting soft feel for the whole family.

HIGHLY DURABLE AND ABSORBENT- This durable bathroom rug is what you need to protect your feet from cold floor as well as wet bathroom floor,to keep you more safe and cozy. Do not place mat on wet surface. The absorbent Sheen Decor bath rug provides the ultimate in plush softness with a thick sheared surface that is exceptionally smooth to the touch.
MULTIPLE USE - This is a multi-functional rug. Put them in living room, outside of bathroom to absorb water, in the entry way to keep the dust away from your house.

CARE INSTRUCTIONS: Machine Wash Gentle Cycle, Machine wash separately in cold water. Use mild detergent. Do not bleach or dry clean. Do not use fabric softeners or dryer sheets. Do not wring, line dry for best results.
